items.q: When should a changed test suite frighten you?
items.a: On the order of **100 tests**. Agents add end-to-end tests until a simple CRUD app has **thousands or tens of thousands**. He says every company he has worked in has had **end-to-end problems**.

items.q: How many real tasks can he run at once?
items.a: **One or two.** A **10, 15, or 20 minute** wait tempts a third and a fourth. At four he is gone. Slack beside one feature is fine. Two features at once is the edge.

items.q: How does he get ownership back?
items.a: **Slop it to explore**, then design the same features. The careful rebuild is about **half or a quarter** of the lines. This project is heading from roughly **100,000** lines toward **25,000 to 30,000**.

The person who can specify the **tests**, the **server layout**, and the **CLI trade-offs**. Not the person who pastes instructions and merges when the spinner stops. The model **never challenges a bad idea**.
